quietnessArgument: The spike wires no production hook, so quietness on the real suite is argued per scenario class from the fire condition (N = 5 consecutive post-warm-up scans with textNodesSeen > 0 && containersResolved == 0). Initial scan: both suites serve the route-fulfilled mock feed (tests/extension-interactions.js:41-52; tests/extension-smoke.js:44) whose spam-1 bait matches and resolves via the data-id known selector (content.js:34-38), emitting a resolving scan that resets rather than extends — and the 3-invocation warm-up absorbs the idle-callback plus hydration rounds (content.js:767-772). Dynamic append: every evaluate-appended section carries a data-id urn:li:activity:* hook (e.g. tests/extension-interactions.js:160,1947,2923), so each debounced observer scan (content.js:1207-1217) resolves and resets; appends arrive as isolated invocations that can never chain 5 consecutive qualifying scans on resolving markup. Comment containers: the plan-059 fixture's bait sits in a .comment inside a data-id post (tests/extension-interactions.js:1938-1948) and resolves to the comment element via the comment-preference branch (shared/post-container.js:155-178) — non-null, hence a reset, and its Show-button restore (tests/extension-interactions.js:1994-2009) re-resolves on rescan. Restore/rescan: 'Show all' restore (tests/extension-smoke.js:731), whitelist restores and cooldown/forceShow suppressions all sit downstream of resolution — the counters are keyed to SS_findPostContainer results (content.js:672) before the processed/forceShow admission check (content.js:673-676), so suppressed re-blocks still resolve and reset instead of streaking. Toggle/snooze flows: toggle off/on (tests/extension-interactions.js:323-357) and snooze/cancel (tests/extension-interactions.js:359-393) return before any hook while disabled/snoozed (content.js:667,1209 emit no events), and resume re-scans resolve spam-1 to a reset. Thin point, stated not tuned: rapid successive appends batching inside one 500 ms debounce window (content.js:1217) could merge what the prototype models as separate invocations — the count only moves the streak slower (fewer invocations), never faster, but a build plan must still include browser proof that hydration burst shapes on live DOM cannot produce 5 consecutive qualifying scans, rather than lowering N to fit.
